name: Canli Validation
description: Checks whether a backtest result is real or just the luckiest of the variants tried: deflated Sharpe ratio, CSCV probability of backtest overfitting, data-snooping tests (Hansen's SPA, White's Reality Check, Romano-Wolf StepM), minimum track record and backtest length, haircut Sharpe ratio, a lookahead check for signals and a placebo test for a whole research pipeline.

CANLI_KEY.description: A key issued by POST https://canlicapital.com/api/v1/keys. Without one, the server issues a free key on first use.

CANLI_LOCAL.description: Set to 1 to run the validators on this machine: no key, nothing about the series is sent, and no receipt is stored.

CANLI_TOOLSETS.description: Comma-separated toolsets to list: validate, receipts, company, status, lab, or all.

CANLI_FULL_ENVELOPE.description: Set to 1 to return each validation's full API envelope instead of the compact result.
